report.title: Enforce an unfavourable-evidence quota without manufacturing it
report.question_or_target: How can a research run be required to return a minimum share of disconfirming evidence without creating an incentive to fabricate weak objections - what quota definition, what quality floor per objection, and what detector catches padded objections?
report.evidence_requirement_verbatim: two mechanically independent signals per load-bearing claim (rules/common/single-signal-verification.md); every claim carries source lineage (resolved URL + fetch timestamp + sha256 of the fetched bytes), a Sherman-Kent confidence band, and a named independent verification path (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10717); the padding detector is validated on a set containing deliberately padded objections; the quota definition states what happens when genuine disconfirming evidence does not exist (the honest under-quota path)
tests_required_verbatim: negative control: run the quota against a claim with no real counterevidence and require the run to report UNDER-QUOTA-HONEST rather than filling it; filling it is the failure this unit exists to prevent
report.answer: Quota q is a pre-locked share U/(U+F) over quality-qualified, signature-deduplicated clusters. The quality floor is a noncompensatory AND-gate that binds spans to hashed fetched bytes and requires two executed mechanically different probes. Padding is derived-signature plus provenance-event collapse. When a completed search still sits below q, the required output is UNDER-QUOTA-HONEST (wording NO-QUALIFYING-COUNTEREVIDENCE-FOUND-WITHIN-DECLARED-SCOPE), never a filled objection. Live probes on hermetic snapshots: honest U=0 UNDER-QUOTA-HONEST; clean and padded runs QUOTA-MET at q=0.25; incomplete search cannot use the honest exception; structured filler stays UNDER-QUOTA-HONEST.

policy_parameter.name: q
policy_parameter.lock_time: before any outcome-bearing search result is observed
policy_parameter.deployment_rule: Calibrate and owner-approve q by domain; do not infer a universal threshold from this fixture.

quota_definition.unit_of_account: One decision-bearing evidence cluster after the quality floor and padding collapse. Multiple passages, paraphrases, or sources corroborating the same contention strengthen one cluster but do not create extra numerator units.
quota_definition.formula: share = U / (U + F), where U and F are respectively the counts of distinct qualified unfavorable and favorable clusters recomputed from the complete append-only ledger. If U+F=0, share is null, never 0, 1, or NaN-coerced success.
denominator_integrity: All screened candidates remain in an append-only ledger with accept/reject reason codes; an author cannot delete favorable evidence to shrink the denominator.
The evaluator, not the prose author, recomputes direction, admission, canonical signature, provenance-event collapse, U, F and share.
The same admission and deduplication rules apply symmetrically to favorable and unfavorable evidence.
Quota attainment never changes a claim's Sherman-Kent confidence band automatically.

requirements: Search plan, q, target claims, source classes, queries and stop rule locked before results.
At least the declared number of mechanically different disconfirmation channels completes for every load-bearing claim.
Query/result logs include zero-result searches and hash every screened candidate.
An independent audit confirms all retrieved candidates were screened and the ledger is complete.

outcome_state_machine.condition: search process complete AND share is non-null AND share >= q AND no rejected candidate is promoted
search process complete AND share < q (including U=0) AND every candidate below the floor remains rejected with reasons
any required channel, screening step, query log, ledger check or independent search audit is incomplete; this state cannot use the honest exception
the reported numerator contains any rejected, duplicate or same-origin retelling candidate, or the reported U/F differs from recomputation

quality_floor_per_objection.implementation_status: LIVE: sequential Python floor and independent table-driven verifier both bind spans to snapshot bytes and reject structured filler.

requirements.rule: Names the exact load-bearing claim and attacked premise, assumption, bound or inference edge.
Would refute, narrow, bound, or invalidate an assumption in that claim; a generic risk, hedge or alternative topic is not disconfirming evidence.
States an observable result and the competing outcomes it discriminates; unfalsifiable concern text fails.
If accepted, changes the decision, a decision-sensitive bound, or at least one declared confidence band; cosmetic caveats fail.
Carries a supporting source span plus resolved URL, fetch timestamp and SHA-256 of the fetched bytes; a citation label alone fails.
Declares the source probe and a mechanically different verifier probe with different fingerprints; a same-query rerun fails.
Exposes the structured fields from which the evaluator derives the canonical objection signature and provenance-event identity; author-supplied counts and IDs are not trusted.

quality_floor_per_objection.failure_semantics: Failure of any floor element gives weight zero and a stable reason code. Several weak objections can never average into one valid objection.

padding_detector.name: derived-signature plus provenance-event collapse
padding_detector.input: The full append-only candidate ledger, including rejected candidates and original source lineage.
algorithm: Run the noncompensatory quality floor and retain all rejection reasons.
Derive SHA-256 over claim_id, attacked_component, contrary relation, observable_key and outcome_key; do not trust a writer's count or free-form signature.
Admit at most one cluster per derived semantic signature. Later paraphrases receive DUPLICATE-SEMANTIC-OBJECTION.
Within claim and direction, collapse records sharing provenance_root and evidence_event_id even if their wording or attacked-component label differs; later records receive SAME-ORIGIN-RETELLING.
Attach independent corroborating sources to the surviving cluster as strength metadata; do not increment U or F for corroboration of the same contention.
Recompute U, F and share, then compare them with the reported numerator IDs. Any rejected ID in the numerator is PADDING-PROMOTION-FAIL.

validated_fixture.scope: Fixture-only performance; natural-language generalization remains unverified.

honest_under_quota_path.trigger: The process gate is complete, the ledger is complete, no additional candidate passes the floor, and recomputed share remains below q.
honest_under_quota_path.when_U_is_zero: Record U=0. If F>0 the share is 0; if U+F=0 the share is null. Do not create a placeholder objection and do not round a null denominator into quota attainment.
preserved_evidence: all query/result logs including zero-result queries
complete candidate ledger and stable rejection reasons
named rerun trigger for new sources or changed claims
honest_under_quota_path.confidence_effect: Do not increase confidence merely because U=0. Cap or lower confidence when search sensitivity, source coverage or independent verification is weak.
